segments.text: Your best developer just resigned. No warning. But the signs were there: late nights, lost weekends, falling feedback. Hidden in the data.
Employetics reads daily attendance, tasks and feedback, and ranks who is likely to leave.
It also tells you why. Overtime. Falling peer feedback. So you fix the real cause.
Or just ask the HR assistant. It answers in seconds, from your own data.
Act weeks before the resignation letter.
Employetics. Predict burnout. Keep your people.
